comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
As an editor, I want a traditional Shadcn newsroom steering desk, so that I can browse references and assignments and accept or reject taxonomy/ontology proposals without newspaper chrome.

Acceptance client: Pilobol.us (publication pilobol-us). Implementation lives in AnthusAI/Papyrus at /newsroom/steer.

Out of scope:
- Implementing the UI inside Pilobol.us
- Replacing the existing newspaper /newsroom workspace
- Changing Pretext/reader layout
- New GraphQL models or a parallel CMS

Definition of Done:
- /newsroom/steer is a Shadcn app surface (not newsprint)
- References list with pending/accepted/rejected filters
- Steering-relevant assignments list
- Proposal yes/no voting writes append-only decisions via reviewSteeringProposal (demo local; live userPool)
- Reference accept/reject via reviewReferenceCuration
- Existing /newsroom newspaper workflows remain
- Runnable instructions in README/PR for Pilobol acceptance

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Scope correction from PM: this epic is not the foundation PR. PPY-43704a owns dispatch. This PR will implement only PPY-5a5570 (tenant theme packs) and PPY-cdeedf (newsroom Shadcn chrome). References inbox, proposal votes, concepts, catalog, and pluggable-stack wiring are later children — not in this PR.
